newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica del Peru okays new bond issues.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica del Peru okays new bond issues.

text.p: Peruvian telecommunications firm and local bolsa benchmark, Telefonica del Peru, has approved new issues of fixed-rate and variable- rate bonds, company sources said Monday.

They said the bonds would include, for the first time in Peru, an issue whose profitability would be linked to an instrument in the local market such as Telefonica shares or Peruvian Brady bond prices.
They did not give more details of the upcoming issues, which are part of a global $400 million bond issue up to 1999.
Telefonica is controlled by Telefonica de Espana, which paid $2.002 billion in a 1994 privatization.
